sections.heading: Description
sections.content: The Training Approach guides the setup and usage of training as part of Business Change to support the transformation. It covers developing learning interventions, ensuring early life adoption and effective delivery of new systems and processes. A Training Concept considers the directives given from vision, strategy and training targets, based on three content pillars: Training before GoLive, After GoLive Support, and New Hire Training.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves user competence and confidence. Enhances adoption and performance in new processes. Reduces errors and support needs. Supports sustainable change and capability building. Enables faster realization of transformation benefits.
